query:
select s.rules,
                  coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(f.key, f.kind) from custom_fields f
                            where f.workspace_id = $1), '{}'::jsonb)
                      as "kinds!: Json<HashMap<String, FieldKind>>"
           from segments s where s.workspace_id = $1 and s.id = $2
